description: Omega Forge Wave 0 (D-406) — the Builder Contract as a PACK: SCHEMA (the seven Forge artifact shapes), CONTRACT (the frozen forge.* op wire — 24 ops across 8 Forges, risk per op), POLICY (proposal-only emission, refusal-tested ops, one risk class per plugin, boot never reads ns proposal), TEST (pack conformance). A pack DECLARES; the implementing forge plugins carry capabilities and grants. Passive v1: no ops routed, no capabilities — compositions/forge-*.json grant forge ops to IMPLEMENTING plugins, never to this pack. The catalog is mirrored in src/schemas.ts::FORGE_OP_CATALOG and the pack test proves the two are identical.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: op
fields.doc: the producing op — forge.mine.capture@1

fields.name: mineId
fields.doc: <repo>@<sha> — the pinned mine this receipt attests

fields.name: mineRoot
fields.doc: declared mine root (paths in files[] resolve against it)

fields.name: capturedAt
fields.doc: UTC ISO timestamp of the read

fields.name: fileCount
fields.doc: number of admitted files

fields.name: rootHash

fields.name: files
fields.doc: [{path, hash, bytes, casRef}] — every admitted file, content-addressed

fields.name: refusals
fields.doc: [{path, reason}] — every refused path with its named reason (symlink escape, root escape, unpinned tree…)

schema.doc: Capture receipt@1 — what forge.mine.capture@1 read, when, at what hash. Read-only by construction; the one filesystem seam's proof of restraint.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: path
fields.doc: path inside the pinned mine

fields.name: hash
fields.doc: sha256 of the file bytes

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: file size in bytes

fields.name: language
fields.doc: detected language tag or null

fields.name: exports
fields.doc: exported symbol names (may be empty)

fields.name: imports
fields.doc: imported module names (may be empty)

fields.name: models
fields.doc: data-model names declared in the file (Prisma models, zod schemas…; may be empty)

fields.name: headings
fields.doc: markdown headings (docs files; may be empty)

schema.doc: Inventory row@1 — one row per pinned file: the survey's atom. Optional arrays may be empty; do not invent required fields beyond this declaration.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: subjectPath
fields.doc: the inventoried file this verdict binds to

fields.name: disposition
fields.doc: PORT | DISTILL | REMOVE | DEFER

fields.name: harvestClass
fields.doc: ALGORITHM|SHAPED|SCHEMA|FIXTURE|POLICY|TEST|TOOLING|OTHER, or null when the disposition implies no harvest

fields.name: clusters
fields.doc: cluster ids the subject belongs to

fields.name: boundaries
fields.doc: [{op, rationale, refusable, substitutable, provable}] — admissible ONLY when all three axes are true

fields.name: risks
fields.doc: named risks observed on the subject

fields.name: evidence
fields.doc: resolvable refs backing the verdict

schema.doc: Assay verdict@1 — the cluster/boundary/risk ruling over one subject. A boundary with any axis false must not be proposed as an op (the three-axis test is the admissibility law).

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: namespaces
fields.doc: [{name, writer, readers, retention}] — exactly ONE writer per namespace (the partition invariant)

fields.name: plugins
fields.doc: [{id, ops, writtenNamespace, generality}] — writtenNamespace null is legal only for lenses

fields.name: compositions
fields.doc: [{id, members}] — builder AND product compositions the shape declares

fields.name: mappings
fields.doc: [{source, targetOp, reason}] — mine path to op with the reviewer-checkable reason

schema.doc: Shape blueprint@1 — the namespaces/plugins/compositions plan emitted from an assay. Every namespace exactly one writer; lens plugins null.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: targetPath
fields.doc: where the artifact is proposed to land (scratch/proposal path — never canonical directly)

fields.name: artifactKind
fields.doc: manifest | package | source | fixture | composition | record | doc

fields.name: contentHash
fields.doc: sha256 over the proposed bytes

fields.name: generatedBy
fields.doc: the emitting op id, e.g. forge.author.init@1

fields.name: ledgerRef
fields.doc: resolvable ledger ref or null at write time (the row itself is the entry)

fields.name: authority
fields.doc: MUST be the literal "none" — any other value fails validation (emission confers no authority)

fields.name: justification
fields.doc: plain-language why this artifact should exist

schema.doc: Proposal artifact@1 — the emission ledger row. authority is "none" BY SCHEMA: an implementation emitting "granted" or anything else fails validation, not review.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: subject

fields.name: op
fields.doc: the proving op

fields.name: result

fields.name: checks

fields.name: replayHash
fields.doc: hash over replayed output, or null when the check is not a replay

fields.name: refusalResults
fields.doc: [{name, result}] — every refusal path executed and its verdict

schema.doc: Proof report@1 — conformance/replay/refusal/second-mine evidence in one row-per-check shape.

fields.name: schemaVersion
fields.doc: literal "1"

fields.name: level
fields.doc: speculative | harvested | generic (the evidence axis; promotion is a decision record)

fields.doc: <repo>@<sha> origin mine, or null

fields.doc: paths inside the pinned mine (empty for speculative)

fields.name: harvestClass

fields.name: evidence

schema.doc: Generality stamp@1 — the standalone artifact form of the manifest generality block (stamps emitted by forge.tier.stamp@1 cite the same vocabulary as the manifest axis, D-405).

contract.doc: capture {mineRoot, mineId} → receipt — the ONE filesystem seam; read-only, refuses unpinned trees, symlink escape and root escape (Class 3 despite reading: reading a foreign tree is the highest-risk act in the system)
verify {mineId} → proof report — receipt vs tree re-walk
diff {mineA, mineB} → proof report — two pinned mines compared
list {} → pinned mines known to the vault
run {mineId} → inventory rows — pure: pinned snapshot → inventory
render {inventory} → atlas markdown — pure: inventory → report
run {inventory} → assay verdicts — clusters, boundaries, risks, harvest classes
distill {verdicts} → PORT/DISTILL/REMOVE/DEFER rulings
map {verdicts} → shape blueprint — namespaces, ops, plugin boundaries, composition membership
budget {blueprint} → sizing report against the house heuristics (op count band, one writer per ns, cap smells)
validate {blueprint} → proof report — the three-axis test + one-writer invariant over a blueprint
plugin {spec} → proposal artifacts — Class 2, writes ONLY ns proposal / the scratch proposal path; proposal-only: confers no authority, signs nothing
pack {spec} → proposal artifacts — Class 2, ns proposal only
composition {spec} → proposal artifacts — Class 2, ns proposal only
fixture {spec} → proposal artifacts — Class 2, ns proposal only
record {spec} → proposal artifacts — Class 2, ns proposal only
conform {subject} → proof report — conformance fixtures vs pack.builder shapes
replay {subject} → proof report — byte-identical regeneration outside AUTHORED regions
refusal {subject} → proof report — every refusal path executed and named
secondmine {subject} → proof report — the same pipeline against the synthetic second mine

init {spec} → scaffold artifacts + ns-proposal ledger rows — Class 2, the self-hosting keystone: reproduces plugins/forge-author/ byte-identical from spec/self.json outside FORGE:AUTHORED regions; proposal-only (a human signs, boot never reads the proposal path)
stamp {subject, level, evidence} → generality-stamp proposal — Class 4 governance shape, root-principal constraints (Wave 0 declares the wire only)
promote {subject, evidence} → promotion proposal — decision-record-class, never a flag edit; root principal only (wire declared, lands post-Wave 0)
docs {subjects} → both-axes listing proposal — provenance × generality in plain words (wire declared, lands post-Wave 0)

policy.description: The Builder Contract policy — the ten Wave 0 rows from the construction packet, as data. The forge-surface gate stage (D-406) enforces the mechanically checkable subset; the rest is review discipline with refusal tests as proof.

rows.rule: Emission is proposal-only. Forge-generated artifacts do not sign, commit, grant, or boot.
Emission confers no authority. A human signs; nothing a Forge emits is trusted until signed.
rows.enforced: same as proposal-only — the authority field is schema-pinned to 'none'

rows.rule: Capture is read-only and refuses unpinned trees, root escapes, and symlink escapes.
rows.enforced: capture-receipt refusals[] + refusal tests when forge.mine lands

rows.rule: Every Forge op ships a refusal test — happy path alone is not coverage.
Every plugin and pack declares generality.
No forge.* op may appear in a product composition.
No plugin may span multiple risk classes — grants are per-plugin.
Class-2 emission writes only to ns proposal or the gate-designated scratch proposal path.
Boot never reads the proposal path — provisional artifacts cannot boot themselves.
rows.enforced: real-boot falsifier (forge-author self-host test) + D-400 precedent

rows.rule: Generated structure replays byte-identically; authored logic is excluded ONLY via explicit FORGE:AUTHORED markers or declared authored files.

policy.doc: builder.policy@1 — the Builder Contract's ten policy rows as declarative data.

test.doc: Pack conformance: the seven artifact schemas validate their fixtures (valid accept, invalid reject), the plugin.json contract catalog equals src/schemas.ts::FORGE_OP_CATALOG exactly, and fixtures are hash-pinned.

capabilities.justification: A pack is passive declarations: no ops to route, no ports to call, no host capabilities. The implementing Forge plugins carry the capabilities; compositions/forge-*.json grant forge ops to those plugins, never to this pack.
